ambiguities.description: The mentee-side uniqueness role in 'Employee mentors Employee' was labeled 'Employee mentee' to distinguish it from the mentor role, since both roles are played by the same Employee entity type. Confirm that the internal_uniqueness constraint correctly targets only the mentee (is mentored by) role, not the mentor role, since a mentor can have many mentees.

source_references.excerpt: Each employee has at most one mentor, who is also an employee.
Yes, a mentor can have many mentees. It is the mentee side that is limited to one mentor.

ambiguities.description: It is unclear whether project assignment is time-bound (i.e., whether the 'at least one, at most three' constraint applies at any point in time, allowing employees to be reassigned over time) or whether this is a static all-time limit. No start/end dates for assignments were discussed, so historical tracking of project assignments is unaddressed.

Clarify whether there's a grace period or if this is strictly always enforced.
